note_en: 边…边… is the casual short form of 一边…一边…: two actions happening at once, with 一 dropped. In the text: 边听音乐边挥汗如雨 "sweating buckets while listening to music"; 妈妈边走边哼着那首歌 "Mom hummed the song as she walked"; 边看视频边跟着做 "following along while watching the video." The short form suits brief verbs; with longer phrases people usually keep 一边.
